description:

summary: # CLO6.1 New Feature Live Replay ## Introduction Hello, everyone! Can you hear us? Today, we are going to do a new 6.1 live stream. We will talk about these 10 modules. I will discuss the first five modules, and then I will cover the last five modules. You can start taking notes with your notebooks. Let's begin today's live stream! If you have any questions, feel free to ask them in the chat. ## Overview of 6.1 Live Stream This 6.1 live stream focuses on 10 modules, which I will explain one by one. The first module will cover new features. Here is the list we will discuss today. ## Module 1: Software Page Updates First of all, let's take a look at our 6.1 software page. You will notice that we have made a small change on the page; the toolbar, which was previously defaulted at the top, has now been moved to the left side. This adjustment allows for better visibility of all the tools, as they are more accessible when placed on the left side. You can connect to our website, Closet Connect, within the software. Here, you can see the products that are on sale or have already been purchased. Closet Connect is developed by Closet Lab and MaxPlace, serving as an open resource-sharing and communication platform. You can upload or download various items, such as clothes, fabric, or accessories. Some files here are free to download. ## Module 2: New Model in the Library Next, we have added a new model in our library called Amta. Let's take a look at the resources we have added for female models. In addition to female models, we have also introduced a male model, which is a black model. ## Module 3: Editor 3D Feature Another new feature is called Editor 3D. This allows us to directly edit the editor in the 3D window, and it can also be connected to the 2D version. ### Tools Overview There are three tools in total: 1. **Editor Shape Line Tool**: First, select the version that needs to be edited, and then speed it up. Click on the point to drag the point of this version, moving along with each other. By moving the line, you can change the frequency of this line. All these changes can be seen in the 2D window. 2. **Zoom Shape Line Tool**: If you select the version that needs to be edited, you can zoom in on this shape line to increase the frequency. You can also zoom in on a specific point. 3. **3D Shape Line Tool**: Click on the shape line in the 3D version. If you double-click on the version, you will see a straight line. Left-clicking will create a curve, and our version will be edited according to the shape line. If you have any questions about the new features, please post them in the comments. I will explain them to you at any time. ## Module 4: Selection Grid Function Next is a function called the Selection Grid. We can utilize the selection grid tool. Let's take a look. First, in the upper right corner of the page, we can make adjustments to the brush's strength, focal length, and size. After making these adjustments, we can select the grid in the 3D window. The grid in the 3D window is thinner than the grid in other places. We can separate the grid in the horizontal direction. In addition to selecting the grid in the 3D window, we can also select it in the 2D version and make it a part of the fixed frame. We can also choose to make it a horizontal freeze, ensuring that the grid does not move when we are editing. ## Module 5: Customizing the Virtual Model The next feature allows us to customize the parts of the virtual model. This function is called the "Face of the Virtual Model." Let's see how to edit the face of the virtual model. First, we need to select the virtual model and click on Edit. Here, you will see the face of the virtual model. We will translate the virtual model later in the video, so don't worry about that. You can select the skin model of the virtual model and choose the color of the hair and skin from the color card on the right side. You can choose a suitable mixing mode, as the effects of different mixing modes vary. You can adjust the color of the eyebrows and lips as well. ## Module 6: UV Editor Now, let's move on to the UV Editor. Here, we can save the cover version with pimples. You can repeat this process multiple times to create textures. First, go to the UI editor mode, click on the backup texture, and choose a save path. You can save it as a normal PNG or JPG format. We've also added a PDF format for saving. Here, we can save it all simultaneously, such as text, metal, hair, light, and transparency. You can choose the desired save picture and click on the save button. If it is a non-magnificent costume but also contains cherry blossoms, we can use a unified sticker for it. ## Module 7: GRTF Unified Function Finally, we can add a new function called GRTF Unified. Here, we can import the physical properties and text of the texture into GRTF format. Choose the fabric GRTF to import the text of the texture, then click Save. As you can see, there are only three objects in total, but in the object window, there are four fabrics. This is because the fabric at the top is a Substance fabric, which we cannot export due to licensing issues. We can only export a fabric for our system's automatic production. ## Module 8: Saving 3D Clothing Records Now let's discuss the update that allows you to save the 3D clothing record in the GPRG file. To do this, open the history record, and there will be a 3D clothing record in the upper right corner. By clicking here, you can record 3D clothing. After making modifications, click on the record 3D clothing again to create a new record. You will notice that the 3D clothing records saved in the GPRG file are easier for us to compare and confirm designs during the design process. ## Module 9: Center Axis for Rotating Videos The second new feature allows us to set the center axis for rotating the video. When we rotate the video, we can choose from three new options: Automatic, Center of the 3D Logo, and Custom Axis. Each option will rotate the video to the specified center, allowing for more control over the presentation. Our videos now support mp4 format, in addition to the original avi format. ## Module 10: Additional Updates Lastly, there are additional updates in the 3D window, including the 3D Fast Frame to display or hide the grid. We can also distribute JRTF, where we can display colors and animations for costumes. Additionally, we can now apply Substance fabric not only to our fabric but also to virtual models and buttons. ## Conclusion We have covered the main new features of the 6.1 update and optimization. If you have any questions or need clarification, please feel free to ask. Thank you for joining us today!
